data.body: **[P2] Preserve registration-order startup context.** This creates every plugin before any `onInvocationStart` runs. Both OTel factories now bind the global provider, inspect `Span.current()`, and start the Invocation span in their constructors. A preceding plugin's start hook therefore cannot initialize the provider or install per-invocation context before OTel captures it, causing missing telemetry or incorrect parentage. Create and start each plugin in one registration-order loop before publishing the completed list, or defer OTel setup to its start hook with safe publication; update the ordering test accordingly.
